title: What Happens When a Neutron Star Teaspoon Pierces Earth?
description: An energetic documentary short detailing the terrifying physics of bringing a teaspoon of neutron star material to Earth.

shots.narration: In 15 seconds, a neutron star teaspoon drills straight down into Earth!
A standard teaspoon holds about 5 millilitres of extreme cosmic matter.
This material weighs over 1 billion tons, matching the mass of Mount Everest.
Four billion tonnes equals about 1,000 Great Pyramids of Giza compressed together tightly.
Such extreme density packs the Sun into a sphere just 20 kilometres wide.
Earth's crust cannot withstand this incredible weight and localized pressure.
The dense object immediately begins a free-fall straight through the planet.
As it plunges deeper, it gains immense speed racing toward the core.
It overshoots the centre completely and surges upward to the opposite side.
Earth's powerful gravity then tugs it right back toward the deep centre.
Oscillating like a playground swing, it picks up underground rock fragments.
It grows significantly larger as it sweeps through successive planetary layers.
Eventually, the massive falling chunk slows down and settles permanently.
Thrown with escape velocity, it would zoom right off into empty space.
Or it might circle back around like a terrifying super-dense cosmic boomerang.
Without crushing stellar gravity, internal degeneracy pressure takes over in microseconds.
It would explode outward with roughly the terrifying energy of a nuclear weapon.
Scorching surface temperatures reaching millions of degrees Celsius trigger instant worldwide firestorms.
Lethal high-energy particles and gamma rays would completely strip our fragile ozone layer.
This single teaspoon completely vaporizes a substantial portion of our entire planet.
